summary.text: Alex Dallman is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 39 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Michael Skivington.

paragraphs.text: Alex Dallman was born in Markesan, Wisconsin, lives in Green Lake and graduated from Markesan High School.
He earned a B.S. in political science from Edgewood College and worked as an outreach representative in the office of Congressman Glenn Grothman.
Dallman won the 2020 general election for Assembly District 41, defeating Nate Zimdars and Jean Bartz, and was re-elected there in 2022.
He won the 2024 general election for District 39, defeating Chris Gordon.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Finance Committee and the Joint Finance Committee.
